test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** "pursuing" fits well in this context,** as it conveys the idea of actively engaging in or following activities that bring relaxation and enjoyment.
 
• **"Pursuing hobbies"** is a common collocation that means engaging in hobbies.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Taking time to unplug and engage in activities that promote relaxation, such as spending time in nature, pursuing __hobbies, or simply enjoying quality time with loved ones....................."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "chasing"** – This is incorrect because "chasing" implies actively pursuing something in a relentless manner, which does not fit the relaxing and leisurely context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "constructing"** – This is incorrect because "constructing" means building or creating something, which does not fit the context of engaging in hobbies for relaxation.
 
• **Option 4: "trailing"** – This is incorrect because "trailing" means following behind, which does not fit the context of engaging in relaxing activities.
